_comment: Pinned sidecar downloads for scripts/fetch-binaries.ps1 (Windows) and scripts/fetch-binaries.sh (Linux).
sha256 is the hash of the downloaded file (the .exe/binary for yt-dlp, the archive for ffmpeg).
If sha256 is set and the download does not match, the script fails. If sha256 is empty, the script prints the computed hash and continues.
yt-dlp hashes are pinned from the release's SHA2-256SUMS file.
ffmpeg is NOT pinned: the BtbN 'latest' URLs change with every daily build. TODO: pin the hash after the first CI run prints it.
Better: replace 'latest' with a dated BtbN tag (autobuild-YYYY-MM-DD-HH-MM) before pinning, otherwise a pinned hash breaks on the next BtbN build.
